title: Fixed Three Drone Bagpipe Display
description: One newly authored complete static three-drone bagpipe exterior. One asymmetric thick inflated bag supports three unequal long fixed drone pipes, a separate forward-angled blowpipe and a downward chanter exterior. Each pipe has its own complete stock/collar attachment; the long drones and other distal ends have real recessed open mouths rather than painted black discs. No previous panflute pipes or organ meshes are copied, extracted or rescaled: the complete central bag, five differently directed attached pipes and all stepped profiles are new. The open-top graduated parallel bundle of a panflute and the large windchest/manual/pedal console of an organ are different whole arrangements. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, native Z up and complete horizontally centred ground origin. One instrument-shaped prop, zero scenes, people, straps or logos. Empty static artistic exterior only; the bag is a closed visual solid and distal mouth recesses do not establish connected air passages, reeds, working finger holes, pressure storage, acoustic tuning, pitch, sound, performance, playability, cultural authenticity, manufacture or safety.
